main_text.l: & Græcis subnixas, ita relinquere non
potui, quin semper aliquid de sub-
scisivo tempore illis tribuerem. Ex
quo quoque hæ qualescunque animad-
versiones, quas in subsidium memoriæ
adnotavi, ne fugitiva oblivio eas mi-
hi subduceret, & quæ nunc in publi-
cum egrediuntur suum ortum habent.
Nec profecto ullum fore credo, qui ad
talia transcendere illicitum putet mihi
aut aliis, quos suus ordo locusque in aliis
muniis detinet. Homo Musarum sacris
initiatus, non est (ut ait Cæcilius) unius
operis remex & baiulus, generosa mens
ad unius res miscellam scientiam non ad-
stringitur, neque alligatur: semper sese
versat illa, concutitque, quicquid pul-
chrum & scitu dignum videt, id omne
scit esse suum. Divinæ virgines musæ
adstant ubique, & omnes ad se invitant,
neminem illæ aversantur qui bonam
spem non curavit. Iubent omnes exsur-
gere, animos sumere, & se quoque hone-

page.notes: The page is a single column with no page number, running head or catchword. Small pen-like marks in the right margin are not printed text and are left out. The final word is broken at the line end as "hone-" with its printed hyphen. "ciuravit" was printed with a u for the vowel and is given as "curavit" under the u/v rule; the word may be a printing error for another verb and should be checked against the scan.
